subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Dr. Sofia Bergman is a Swedish marine biologist.
• Marine biologists study ocean organisms.
• Baleen whales are some of the most studied cetaceans.
• Baleen whales were first systematically studied in the late twentieth century.
• Bergman is known for her research on humpback and blue whales, two species of baleen whales.
prompt: The student wants to provide an example of a marine biologist whose research focuses on baleen whales. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Baleen whales are a type of ocean organism that marine biologists are still working to understand.
choices.B: Marine biologist Dr. Sofia Bergman is known for her research on humpback and blue whales.
choices.C: By studying humpback and blue whales—to name just one example—marine biologists can learn more about baleen whales.
choices.D: The research done on humpback and blue whales exemplifies the work marine biologists do to advance our understanding of ocean organisms.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer because it directly accomplishes the stated goal of providing an example of a marine biologist whose research focuses on baleen whales. The sentence names a specific marine biologist, Dr. Sofia Bergman, and identifies her area of research: humpback and blue whales. Since humpback and blue whales are types of baleen whales (as indicated by the notes), this choice effectively uses relevant information to fulfill the rhetorical purpose of providing a concrete example of an individual researcher in this field.
